scope: Independent visual review of five original marketing images and all twenty desktop/mobile closed/open screenshots, with each source_readme.md read.
method: Each original image was individually inspected with vision_analyze, not inferred from contact sheets. Paths below are relative to this QA root.
assessment_limits: Static screenshots do not independently verify runtime interaction, physical-phone performance, hidden surfaces, attachment geometry or continuous collision clearance.
Source README verification claims are context, not tests independently rerun by this reviewer.
Greater promotional realism is not itself a functional defect. Candidate recommendations are not human approval or release authorization.
Front-open views generally turn exterior lid ornaments away from the camera; lack of their visibility is not evidence of missing ornaments.

japan.readme_context: Cedar v2 explicitly documents a stylized, airy miniature conifer, planar/stippled branch tiers and mobile moss detail limits after one bounded visual correction.

observations.observation: Labeled promotional illustration: dense, organically clustered miniature tree and plush moss on granite; warm grained wood, brass hardware, green seam and stone feet. More realistic surface treatment than runtime.

Wood/joinery, brass, moss-rock base and conifer remain identifiable. Runtime tree is smaller/airier and stippled, wood brighter orange and hardware flatter than marketing. Broad green lid reveal is conspicuous. Whole silhouette fits.
Empty wood-toned cavity, green rim, two rear hinge fittings and raised latch tab are visible. Exterior tree turns away. Entire lid/tab/feet fit; no unequivocal missing geometry or detached component.
Chest and buttons remain fully framed; tree silhouette is recognizable but fine foliage and moss are weak at native scale. Orange wood dominates the nature motif. No visible layout overlap.
Open cavity and brass fittings remain readable at overview scale, with lower floor partly hidden by front wall. Raised lid and feet fit; small hinge contacts cannot be judged precisely.

limitations: Promotional dense foliage/plush moss is not reproduced photorealistically; documented stylization rather than functional failure.
Green seam can make closed lid look slightly raised; no closure failure established.
Fine foliage aliases and mobile moss/hinge details are small; lower interior and rear contacts are partly occluded.
japan.rationale: Coherent theme and intact closed/open framing on both sizes; observed weaknesses align with documented limits, with no confirmed visual blocker.

latvia.readme_context: Invented cream/carmine linen-inspired motif, three deliberately opaque amber cabochons; weave resolution, rigid insert appearance and conspicuous seam disclosed. No original reference artwork existed during authoring.

observations.observation: Light wood and dark finger joints frame a smooth ivory panel with burgundy stripes and three peach-orange domes on square brass settings. Stone-like feet and gold fittings; polished presentation.

Cream/carmine panel and three honey-yellow domes read clearly. Weave is not convincingly resolved and domes are more opaque/yellow than promotional peach gloss. Pronounced dark closed seam; full silhouette visible.
Plain warm wood lid underside and empty cavity, rear hinge fittings, front hardware and raised tab are visible. Ornaments face away naturally. All parts fit without cropping.
Three ornaments and cream/red panel remain distinguishable. Seam stays dark and conspicuous; fine textile detail disappears. Model, title and both controls fit without overlap.
Open cavity and two rear fittings remain legible, floor partly obscured. Small fittings have coarse edges; no obvious detached part or UI clipping.

limitations: Linen reads as a rigid insert and weave is unresolved at mobile scale.
Amber is opaque and stylized; promotional versus runtime hue/gloss differs without indicating malfunction.
Dark closed seam reads raised; documented design concern rather than demonstrated bad closure.
Front-open view hides lid ornament and small contact details.
latvia.rationale: Core panel/three-cabochon motif survives both viewport sizes and all poses are fully framed; limitations are disclosed and no unmistakable visual failure is shown.

madagascar.readme_context: Procedural limestone pinnacles and sheltered green patches, not geographical reconstruction. Regular peak field/body flutes, shallow vegetation and wavy interior map are disclosed.

observations.observation: Ivory marbled/ribbed chest with jagged faceted stone peaks, sage green accents, antique brass and dark rounded feet. Strong sculptural limestone silhouette.
Pale pointed forest, ribbed shell, green seam and brass remain coherent. Pinnacles are simplified and crowded at their bases; no obvious missing faces or floating pieces. Entire object fits.
Dark gray-green wavy inner walls contrast with pale patterned lid underside and green rim. Two rear brass fittings visible; front wall hides much of floor. No cropping.
Pointed limestone motif remains strong. Neighboring pale peaks merge and sheltered green patches are subtle; lower feet have low contrast. Title, controls and complete silhouette fit.

Dark patterned cavity and pale rippled lid underside remain visible with rear hinges/front hardware. Depth and tiny contacts are unclear, but no unequivocal damaged/missing geometry or overlap is shown.

limitations: Regular simplified peaks/flutes do not reproduce a dense natural tsingy labyrinth.
Green vegetation is subtle at mobile scale and neighboring ivory peaks lose separation.
Wavy procedural interior/underside shading is prominent; interior depth and floor remain partly hidden.
Closed seam is conspicuous but consistent with the family design.
madagascar.rationale: Limestone identity is clear on both sizes, full open/closed framing is intact, and no definitive structural or UI visual defect appears.

mauritius.readme_context: Seven lid-parented rolling mineral ribbons; README explicitly says not all seven can be visually counted at mobile scale, walls may read as clay, and seam/long clasp are deliberate family geometry.

observations.observation: Peach-pink grained chest with pastel rolling bands in pink, yellow, sage, blue/lavender and taupe. Brass fittings, dark feet and narrow dark lid band; polished landscape relief.
Pastel flowing lid relief survives over a warmer terracotta shell. All seven bands cannot confidently be counted. Broad dark seam makes lid look slightly ajar; whole chest fits.
Warm wavy lid underside and empty matching cavity, dark rim, two rear hinges and projecting tab visible. Rim corners are segmented but not conclusively broken. Full framing retained.
Colored-earth lid remains recognizable, but pastel regions blend and shell material reads ambiguously as clay/copper/resin. Full model and wrapped title fit; buttons do not overlap.

Cavity depth is subtle because walls/floor share warm tones; projecting tab is prominent and small hardware simplified. Entire raised lid, feet and controls fit. Exterior ribbons face away, so their count cannot be assessed here.

limitations: Seven separate mineral ribbons are not confidently countable from supplied default views; source claim is not independently verified by these stills.
Marketing has finer wood/material finish and clearer pastel separation; runtime is a stylized clay-like interpretation.
Dark seam and long clasp are visually prominent but disclosed; no mechanical failure demonstrated.
Uniform interior tones reduce depth clarity and small rim junctions are hard to inspect.
mauritius.rationale: Rolling-earth motif and layout are coherent in both sizes; documented material/count-readability limits warrant disclosure, not automatic functional rejection.

mozambique.readme_context: Three raised sandbanks and opaque mapped turquoise water; simple pointed reliefs, wood-like shell ripples, raised-looking seam and ambiguous front-open hinge connection are explicitly disclosed. Source claims attachment tests, not independently rerun here.

observations.observation: Ivory chest and feet with glossy turquoise lid, three cream raised forms and brass fittings. Two pointed forms can read as mountains or cream dollops rather than broad dunes; theme is not unambiguous without context.

Cream/turquoise/brass palette and raised dune forms remain readable. Pointed reliefs read somewhat mountain-like, regular shell ridges wood-like. Thick dark seam suggests a slightly raised lid. Complete model framed.

Turquoise visible lid face with winding dark channel, cream empty cavity and two brass hinge-like fittings. Dark gap makes connection visually ambiguous/slightly floating; no part is conclusively detached. Full raised silhouette fits.
Ivory dunes on turquoise remain visible with front clasp bridging the dark seam. Full chest and controls fit; pale forms simplify at this scale.

Cream cavity remains coherent, while small brass pieces and dark rear gap make lid-to-body contact difficult to trace. Slight detached appearance persists, not proof of disconnected geometry. No model cropping or UI overlap.

review_concerns: Front-open hinge connection reads visually ambiguous/slightly floating on desktop and mobile. This is a presentation concern, not established detached geometry.
Closed seam strengthens the raised-lid impression; independent still review cannot resolve attachment/closure certainty.
limitations: Dunes are simple pointed reliefs that can read as mountains/dollops; water is opaque mapped color rather than fluid.
Shell ripples are regular/wood-like and interior depth subtle.
Still images cannot supersede the existing review hold or independently establish mechanical correctness.
mozambique.rationale: Preserve the existing Mozambique hold. Supplied desktop/mobile open views retain the documented attachment ambiguity; no approval or promotion is granted, despite no conclusively demonstrated detached part.
